subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------SPT.DY.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 231 (T(IMP)M-29). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject; SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From RT-ALGN: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From INDIV-TD: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: V-SY (value system). From INFO-SOLD: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From VT-PLT: INTR (interpretation, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of").
